data.title: Qatar Condemns in Strongest Terms Continued Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Doha, November 19, 2026, SPA -- The State of Qatar condemned in the strongest terms the continued attacks by the Houthi group against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, targeting civilian and economic facilities and civilian objects in Riyadh and causing material damage to the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD). Qatar described these attacks as disgraceful acts of aggression that demonstrate an unacceptable disregard for civilian lives, a flagrant violation of the Kingdom's sovereignty, and a clear breach of international law.
    In a statement issued today, the Qatari Ministry of Foreign Affairs stressed Qatar's categorical rejection of attacks against civilians and civilian objects. It emphasized the need for an immediate halt to these irresponsible acts.
    The ministry reiterated Qatar's full solidarity with Saudi Arabia and its support for all legitimate measures the Kingdom takes to safeguard its sovereignty, security, territorial integrity, and interests. It affirmed that Saudi Arabia's security is integral to Qatar's security and the collective security framework of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states.
    -- SPA
